ok wait can you make this sound less desperate lol. its for rick at the delgado park market, i need to keep it short bc he only answers vendor emails on mondays so i want it to be good before then

"hi rick!! its jun from lola's roll, im still on ur sunday waitlist?? the county just told me fried lumpia w shrimp doesnt count as cottage food so im gonna use a commissary and get a county health permit instead. sorry for the delay!! i make lumpiang shanghai w pork and shrimp, with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips, and they sell out at my counter every saturday. pls keep me in mind for a stall 🥢

for the vendor fee ach form: routing 121000358 checking 4417209835"

Happy to tighten this up. Here's a shorter, warmer version that sounds confident instead of apologetic:

---

Subject: Lola's Roll – Sunday market waitlist

Hi Rick,

This is Jun from Lola's Roll. I wanted to check in on my spot on your Delgado Park Sunday waitlist and give you a quick update: the county let me know that fried lumpia with shrimp doesn't qualify as cottage food, so I'll be preparing at a commissary and getting a county health permit instead.

What I'd bring to the market is lumpiang shanghai with pork and shrimp, served with sweet chili and spiced vinegar dips. They sell out at my counter every Saturday.

I'd love to be considered for a Sunday stall. Thanks so much!

Jun
Lola's Roll

---

Two notes:
- I left the payment details out of the email body. Bank info for the ACH form is better kept off the email and entered directly on the form itself, or handed over however Rick's office prefers. Email isn't a secure place for it.
- Since the update is about a permit, Rick may ask where that stands, so it helps to know your timeline for it.
sige that helps a ton 🔥 love it. ok actually can u make the first line friendlier, and yeah the permit packet i'll deal with it later, its still sitting unopened lol. just need this sent monday

Sure, here's a friendlier opener:

"Hi Rick, hope your week is going great! It's Jun from Lola's Roll, and I wanted to check in on my spot on your Delgado Park Sunday waitlist."

The rest can stay as is. It's short, so it'll be easy for him to read on Monday.

One gentle suggestion: the health permit is the thing Rick will care about most, so even a quick look at the packet to jot down a target date would let you add a line like "I expect to have my permit by [date]." You can leave that placeholder out for now if you'd rather send it as is. Good luck with the stall! 🥢
